text.p: Hi-Rise Recycling Systems Inc said Friday that it has signed an agreement with Ecolo Odor Control Systems, a division of Sager Industries Ltd of Canada, for the U.S. private label distribution rights of its odor control dispensing system.
The company said it believes this line will generate about $125,000 in sales during the fourth quarter of 1997 and approximately triple that in 1998.

The agreement calls for Hi-Rise to receive private label distribution rights for multistory buildings with rubbish or linen chutes in the United States, including apartments, hospitals, hotels and commercial buildings.
The company said this represents a substantially new market for the product line, to be sold under the Wilkinson name.
Hi-Rise markets, designs, manufactures, sells, installs and services patented and propriety recycling systems and products for multi-story residential buildings.
